4251111b-206d-81d7-bd96-001c3d30fb02: No Development Zone (CRZ) = a strip from the high-tide line where new construction is banned.

K-SHORE = Karnataka Strengthening Coastal Resilience and Economy: ₹840 crore, 7-year World Bank project for erosion control, mangroves, dunes and keeping plastic out of the sea (part of the World Bank's SHORE programme with Tamil Nadu).
4251111b-206d-8110-a833-001c0c289fa0: CETP = Common Effluent Treatment Plant: one shared treatment plant for a cluster of small factories that can't afford their own.

NMCG = National Mission for Clean Ganga (2011): the body that runs Namami Gange. NGRBA = National Ganga River Basin Authority (2009, PM-chaired): the first basin-level body, replaced by the National Ganga Council (2016).
4251111b-206d-817c-8292-001c266e2328: GAP = Ganga Action Plan (1985), India's first river-cleaning plan. NGRBA = National Ganga River Basin Authority (2009).
NMCG = National Mission for Clean Ganga: the body that runs Namami Gange.
4251111b-206d-818a-9583-001ce3a88ac8: MARPOL = treaty on pollution from ships (oil, sewage, garbage). SOLAS = treaty on ship safety. IMDG Code = rules for carrying dangerous goods by sea.
SOLAS 1974 = IMO's Safety of Life at Sea convention (how ships are built, fire safety, lifeboats). IMDG Code = how dangerous goods must be packed, labelled and declared on ships.
4251111b-206d-8179-ac7d-001ce4fe9579: Green Energy Open Access = big consumers (100 kW+) can buy green power directly from any producer instead of only their DISCOM.

Status: Karnataka HC struck the central Rules down in Jan 2025 (only state commissions can make open-access rules) → states now notify their own green open access regulations (Haryana, Rajasthan 2025; Delhi 2026).
4251111b-206d-8135-bd44-001cec53684e: Airshed = the whole area that shares the same air (e.g. Delhi + Haryana + UP + Punjab for NCR), since pollution doesn't stop at city borders.
4251111b-206d-813b-9049-001c946220cb: Living Planet Report = WWF's report tracking how fast wild animal populations are shrinking worldwide.
4251111b-206d-81d2-a489-001ccf914d6c: Adjudicating officer = a government officer (not a court) who decides the fine for a violation, so cases end faster.
4251111b-206d-81b4-bfb2-001c5c905821: Environment Protection Fund = a pot where all the environmental fines go, to be spent on environmental work.
4251111b-206d-811d-aa11-001c7047d453: BMC = Biodiversity Management Committee: a village- or town-level body under the BD Act that records local biodiversity and decides on its use.
4251111b-206d-81d7-a95d-001c20d2c879: Lantana = a fast-spreading invasive shrub from South America that chokes native plants; it covers about half of India's forests and scrubland.
4251111b-206d-81ac-88bb-001c2a210d29: Key Biodiversity Areas = sites mapped globally as the most important places for species survival.
4251111b-206d-819c-942d-001c44d28550: PVTG = Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group: the most isolated, smallest tribes, like the Shompen.
4251111b-206d-8109-99b4-001ca98a5702: Megathrust = the giant fault where one tectonic plate dives under another; it causes the biggest earthquakes and tsunamis.
4251111b-206d-81f0-965c-001cf70ef786: Vermin = an animal the Centre declares a pest (WPA Section 62) so it can be legally killed for a period, e.g. wild boar raiding crops.
4251111b-206d-810c-b711-001ca0bc37ee: Zoonoses = diseases that jump from animals to humans (Nipah, COVID-19, rabies).
4251111b-206d-8114-b0cb-001cdc610cdf: ADSI = Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India, NCRB's yearly report.
4251111b-206d-8174-88e3-001c41a70279: SOP = standard operating procedure: a fixed step-by-step drill for officials when, say, a tiger enters a village.
4251111b-206d-8160-b107-001ce969fd38: Landscape approach = plan for the whole area animals move through (forests, farms, villages), not just the fenced park.
4251111b-206d-81c1-8e76-001c530c4b6b: NBWL = National Board for Wildlife (chaired by PM): clears projects inside protected areas. NTCA = National Tiger Conservation Authority (runs tiger reserves). WCCB = Wildlife Crime Control Bureau. CZA = Central Zoo Authority.
4251111b-206d-8121-8899-001cd3689da6: TX2 = the global goal (2010) to double wild tigers by 2022; India did it in 2018, four years early.
4251111b-206d-8159-a9d2-001cc2b03319: Biopiracy = companies patenting or profiting from a country's plants or traditional knowledge without permission or sharing benefits (e.g. the neem and turmeric patent fights).
4251111b-206d-8107-ac0f-001cd172a8d0: Biodiversity Heritage Site = a small, rich area a state notifies under the BD Act for protection with local people (e.g. Arittapatti, Madurai).
4251111b-206d-81ae-a502-001c6d83cc59: AYUSH = Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homoeopathy. The 2023 amendment freed these practitioners from asking NBA before using plants.
4251111b-206d-81aa-ad26-001cde8d45c7: Digital sequence data (DSI) = genetic code of plants or animals stored online; companies can use it without touching the physical plant, so it's a new route for biopiracy.
4251111b-206d-811a-88be-001cd99df592: TKDL = Traditional Knowledge Digital Library: India's database of traditional remedies in patent-office languages, so foreigners can't patent them as new. PPVFR Act = protects new seed varieties and farmers' right to save and share seeds. GI Act = protects products tied to a place (Darjeeling tea).
4251111b-206d-81ba-8efe-001c111e256f: Nagoya Protocol (2010) = CBD agreement that whoever uses another country's genetic resources must get permission and share the benefits (access and benefit sharing, ABS).
4251111b-206d-8105-a88a-001c152a842b: PPVFR Act 2001 (Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights): registers new plant varieties for breeders + farmers keep the right to save, use, share and sell seed (not branded). GI Act 1999: Geographical Indication tag for products tied to a place (Darjeeling tea, Basmati).
4251111b-206d-8142-a75b-001c57405581: Eco-sensitive zone = a buffer belt around a national park or sanctuary where harmful activities are banned or controlled.
4251111b-206d-81ab-ad7a-001cb14754d2: WII = Wildlife Institute of India (Dehradun); its DNA lab identifies seized animal parts to prosecute poachers.
4251111b-206d-81f7-908a-001c8916dc73: Eco-bridge = an overpass or underpass built for animals to cross highways and railways safely.
4251111b-206d-813f-9e86-001c6ab4680b: NWAP = National Wildlife Action Plan (2017–31): India's wildlife roadmap (landscape approach, climate, people-centric), but not legally binding.
4251111b-206d-81a3-b24e-001caf2e6796: BIOFIN = Biodiversity Finance Initiative (UNDP): helps countries work out how much conservation costs and where the money can come from. Cali Fund = companies that profit from digital genetic data pay into it; money goes to Indigenous and local communities.
4251111b-206d-816f-b0b9-001caa05ad9e: BRSR = Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report: SEBI makes the top 1,000 listed companies disclose ESG data (energy, emissions, water, waste).
4251111b-206d-8100-85fc-001c1f248a1c: KMGBF = Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework: the 'Paris Agreement for nature' with 23 targets for 2030.
4251111b-206d-81b0-b73a-001cfbc54d39: 30x30 = protect 30% of land and 30% of oceans by 2030.
4251111b-206d-8117-8578-001c10b9fcec: Aichi targets = 20 biodiversity goals set in 2010 for 2020; none was fully met.
4251111b-206d-8159-b14e-001c56e20868: Protected Planet Report = UN report on how much of Earth's land and sea is protected.
4251111b-206d-81ac-9f78-001c1f84e75a: DSI = digital sequence information (genetic data stored online, used by pharma and biotech). Kunming Biodiversity Fund = China-backed fund launched at COP16 to help developing countries meet KMGBF targets.
4251111b-206d-8136-8e7f-001c1306e60a: NBSAP = National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan: each country's plan for meeting the CBD targets.
4251111b-206d-81d8-9cc4-001c5fffbf0d: National report = the progress report every CBD member must submit (Article 26); India's 7th says all 23 targets are on track.
4251111b-206d-812a-8f0d-001c1abafc76: CITES = Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species: Appendix I species can't be traded commercially at all.
4251111b-206d-8120-9898-001c1aa31346: CMS = Convention on Migratory Species (Bonn): protects animals that cross borders (birds, elephants, turtles).
4251111b-206d-81bc-8a46-001cdc1fba72: MAB = UNESCO's Man and Biosphere programme: biosphere reserves where conservation and local livelihoods coexist (core, buffer, transition zones).
4251111b-206d-8172-b4de-001cba247cbc: ITPGRFA = International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture: countries share seeds of key crops for research and breeding.
4251111b-206d-81ec-bdbf-001c07735c44: BBNJ = Biodiversity Beyond National Jurisdiction: the treaty for the high seas, the ocean beyond any country's 200-nautical-mile zone (about two-thirds of the ocean).
4251111b-206d-81fc-aeb4-001c79c8e5f0: ISFR = India State of Forest Report, published every 2 years by the Forest Survey of India.
4251111b-206d-81e9-ab4e-001cbf208586: Hasdeo Arand = a dense forest in Chhattisgarh being cleared for coal mines despite Gram Sabha protests.
4251111b-206d-81ce-986d-001c78cbca57: Reserved forest = strictest (no rights unless granted); Protected forest = some rights allowed; Village forest = given to a village to manage.
4251111b-206d-81ee-93e4-001cdbc9a659: Compensatory afforestation = whoever cuts a forest for a project must pay to plant an equal (or double) area elsewhere.
4251111b-206d-81e9-abdf-001c98728216: PLI = Production Linked Incentive: the government pays makers a share of their extra sales for 4–6 years, to build factories in India (solar modules, batteries, electrolysers).
4251111b-206d-8123-8ef4-001c6b399f83: ISA = International Solar Alliance: India–France-led group of sunny countries (launched at COP21, 2015) to spread solar power; HQ in Gurugram. One Sun Declaration (COP26) = 80+ countries backing the one-world-grid idea.
4251111b-206d-8143-8d39-001ce69347e0: National Offshore Wind Energy Policy 2015: opens India's sea, up to 200 nautical miles (EEZ), to wind farms; NIWE, Chennai, is the nodal agency that allots blocks.
4251111b-206d-8196-bde8-001c121fb1b4: PMKKKY = Pradhan Mantri Khanij Kshetra Kalyan Yojana (2015): spends District Mineral Foundation money on the people and areas hit by mining.
4251111b-206d-811d-8195-001cb410e925: PFBR = Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor: India's first fast breeder (500 MWe) at Kalpakkam; makes more fuel than it burns.
4251111b-206d-81d1-8ba4-001cb416e16a: National Bioenergy Programme (MNRE, 2022–26): funds waste-to-energy, biomass (briquettes, pellets) and biogas plants.
4251111b-206d-811d-be99-001c2586dab9: India Electric Mobility Index: NITI Aayog + WRI India ranking of states on EV adoption, charging readiness and EV research; 1st edition Aug 2025, 2nd Sep 2026 (Delhi top both times).
4251111b-206d-8155-b545-001c7b82d347: FSI = Forest Survey of India (Dehradun, under MoEFCC): publishes the 2-yearly forest report (ISFR) + sends satellite fire alerts to forest staff.
4251111b-206d-81d6-a281-001cea1ce23e: Green India Mission (2014): one of the 8 NAPCC missions; grow forest and tree cover on 5 million ha + improve the quality of another 5 million ha.
4251111b-206d-812c-ab16-001c4ebdc0d9: ESA = Ecologically Sensitive Area, notified under EPA 1986: mining, quarrying, big building and red-category industry banned inside it.
4251111b-206d-8148-bc0c-001cf2e992ea: CRZ = Coastal Regulation Zone (first 1991, now the CRZ 2019 notification under EPA): limits building and industry near the high-tide line + No Development Zones on the coast.
4251111b-206d-81dd-8af8-001c28c166bf: MISHTI = Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes (Budget 2023): plant mangroves on about 540 sq km in 9 states + 4 UTs, using MGNREGS and CAMPA money.
4251111b-206d-810e-804c-001c76ca2e14: UNOC3 = 3rd UN Ocean Conference, Nice, June 2025 (France + Costa Rica): its Nice Ocean Action Plan pushes ocean funding, marine protected areas and the High Seas Treaty.
4251111b-206d-8101-8856-001cb36034f3: Global Cooling Pledge (COP28): cut cooling-related emissions 68% by 2050 vs 2022 + efficient ACs and fridges. India stayed out because its cooling demand is still growing.
4251111b-206d-814b-b783-001cea4b3e72: Global Green Credit Initiative (India, COP28): credits for planting on degraded land + an online platform to share ideas. Global Biofuel Alliance (India-led, G20 Delhi 2023, with US and Brazil): spread ethanol and other biofuels worldwide.
4251111b-206d-8172-ad2c-001c4cbc317f: NAAQS = National Ambient Air Quality Standards (CPCB, 2009): legal safe limits for 12 pollutants in outdoor air.
4251111b-206d-8111-9500-001cfcbec2f3: IN-GRES = India Groundwater Resource Estimation System: CGWB's online tool that rates every block safe, semi-critical, critical or over-exploited.
4251111b-206d-81c7-b3d6-001c134f425c: INC = Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee, set up by the UN Environment Assembly (2022) to write a global plastics treaty; talks failed at Busan (2024) and Geneva (2025).
4251111b-206d-818f-a984-001cf4b35473: India Plastics Pact (CII + WWF India, 2021, first in Asia): companies pledge all plastic packaging reusable or recyclable by 2030. Un-Plastic Collective (UNEP + CII + WWF India, 2019): voluntary company pledges to cut plastic waste.
4251111b-206d-811e-abe6-001c47d17568: Steel Scrap Recycling Policy (2019): framework for organised scrapping centres, so old vehicles and goods become scrap for steel-making instead of imported scrap.
4251111b-206d-81aa-bc5e-001c57d06d2f: National Critical Mineral Mission (2025, ₹16,300 crore): find, mine and process critical minerals (lithium, cobalt, rare earths) at home and abroad + incentives to recover them from e-waste and old batteries.
4251111b-206d-8143-bb03-001cc1fed67d: CWC = Central Water Commission: apex technical body for surface water (dams, flood forecasts). CGWB = its groundwater counterpart. Mihir Shah Committee (2016): merge both into one National Water Commission.
4251111b-206d-81be-92d2-001ce6addccb: RISAT = ISRO's Radar Imaging Satellites: see through clouds and at night → spot oil slicks.
4251111b-206d-81a8-a056-001c41fb5312: HADR = Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief: armed forces sent abroad after a disaster (rescue teams, field hospitals, supplies).
4251111b-206d-81e0-b9a0-001cf1ac205d: Here NDRF = National Disaster Response Fund (DM Act, s.46), not the National Disaster Response Force.
4251111b-206d-8107-9306-001ce809d5da: National Earthquake Risk Mitigation Project: NDMA plan for safer buildings (codes, retrofitting, training engineers and masons). National Centre for Seismology (MoES): records every quake and issues alerts.
4251111b-206d-81b5-899c-001cfe9d8290: NRSC = National Remote Sensing Centre (ISRO, Hyderabad): satellite maps for disasters (floods, glacial lakes, fires).
4251111b-206d-8113-832b-001cf6baba28: CWC = Central Water Commission: apex technical body for rivers and dams; runs India's flood forecasts and watches glacial lakes.
4251111b-206d-8109-ac08-001cfca557f9: National Solar Mission (2010): one of the 8 NAPCC missions; first target 20 GW of solar by 2022, raised to 100 GW in 2015.
4251111b-206d-81a7-8c32-001cd3c80ace: SATAT = Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (2018): oil companies promise to buy compressed biogas from new plants that run on farm waste, dung and city waste.
4251111b-206d-812f-b6ae-001cc3ea590b: PARIVESH = online single-window portal (2018) for environment, forest, wildlife and CRZ clearances; 2.0 adds tracking of each proposal.
4251111b-206d-811d-82b1-001c6855209d: C&D Waste Rules 2025 (in force 1 Apr 2026, replace the 2016 rules): builders answer for their debris (EPR) + recycling targets + 5% recycled material in construction from 2026–27, rising to 25% by 2030–31.
4251111b-206d-816a-ad81-001c3e0779cd: Battery Waste Management Rules 2022: EPR for battery makers (collect and recycle all batteries, incl. EV) + minimum recycled content in new batteries + tradable EPR certificates.
4251111b-206d-8151-912b-001c8448a22d: Green Energy Open Access Rules 2022: any consumer with 100 kW+ load (earlier 1 MW) can buy wind or solar power directly from a producer through the grid, not only from its DISCOM. Why it matters: factories and offices can go green on their own → demand for wind and solar grows beyond government auctions and weak DISCOMs + no surcharges for green hydrogen + offshore wind waiver till 2032. Status: Karnataka HC struck the central Rules down (Jan 2025: only state commissions can make open-access rules) → states now make their own green open access regulations.
4251111b-206d-8141-b509-001c600bb26d: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (2024): Centre's mission to bring basic services (houses, water, roads, health) to ≈63,000 tribal-majority villages; sets up FRA cells to settle forest-rights claims.
4251111b-206d-8119-b847-001c5d512926: KBR = Kasu Brahmananda Reddy National Park, Hyderabad.
4251111b-206d-8102-bd02-001c39f8837c: INCOIS Coastal Vulnerability Index: maps how exposed each stretch of India's coast is to sea-level rise, erosion and storm surges.
4251111b-206d-8184-a49b-001cebd51a38: ICZMP = Integrated Coastal Zone Management Project (World Bank-backed): plans the coast as one unit (hazard lines, mangroves, livelihoods). CMIS = Coastal Management Information System: data network that tracks shoreline change.
4251111b-206d-810f-8589-001cb827ab7b: Pachathuruthu = Kerala's "green islets" drive: local bodies and communities plant small native mini-forests on spare public land.
4251111b-206d-81e9-b4a5-001c3e447970: ICA = International Consultation and Analysis: developing countries' self-funded climate actions are only reviewed through consultation, not audited by outsiders.
4251111b-206d-815f-b65a-001c06adb961: Core Carbon Principles = quality benchmark for carbon credits (real, additional, permanent, verified) set by the Integrity Council for the Voluntary Carbon Market.
4251111b-206d-8198-b94d-001c03d7f8a5: HCFC-141b = ozone-depleting gas used to blow foam (fridge and building insulation); India phased it out of foam-making from 1 Jan 2020.
4251111b-206d-8192-97df-001c3e65f291: BRS = Basel (hazardous-waste trade), Rotterdam (prior consent for hazardous chemicals trade) and Stockholm (persistent organic pollutants) conventions, run together by UNEP.
4251111b-206d-81ae-b85f-001cfe8ef8de: Alang, Gujarat = world's largest ship-breaking yard. Hong Kong Convention (IMO, in force June 2025) = safe, clean ship recycling rules.
4251111b-206d-811b-82d8-001c71d3e24e: Trees Outside Forests in India = MoEFCC + USAID programme (2023) to grow trees on farms and private land. SMAF = Sub-Mission on Agroforestry (under the National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture). GROW = NITI Aayog's Greening and Restoration of Wasteland with Agroforestry (maps wasteland fit for agroforestry).
4251111b-206d-8140-b997-001c5240df97: SOE = State of India's Environment report (CSE). Land-system change = one of 9 planetary boundaries: how much forest and natural land can be converted before Earth systems are pushed out of a safe zone.
4251111b-206d-81a1-b375-001c2d170667: IUINDRR-NIDM = Indian Universities and Institutions Network for Disaster Risk Reduction, run by NIDM: links 330+ universities for disaster research and teaching.
4251111b-206d-8193-b8dd-001c56e818e3: SATARK = Odisha's web platform (OSDMA) that sends warnings for many hazards (lightning, heat, floods, drought) to officials and people.
4251111b-206d-81c9-9fe6-001ce0630114: Climate Smart Cities Assessment Framework (MoHUA, 2019): scores cities on climate readiness, incl. flood and water management, green cover, energy and mobility.
4251111b-206d-814f-a4a1-001cb5c92b78: CEA = Central Electricity Authority: its guidelines make hydro projects check slope stability and glacial-lake risk before building.
4251111b-206d-8199-b714-001c991a8eb7: ICRI = International Coral Reef Initiative: a partnership of countries and groups working to protect coral reefs; India is a member.
4251111b-206d-81ae-a9ba-001c19d8e13b: RTDAS = Real Time Data Acquisition System: automatic stations that send live surface- and groundwater-level data, installed under the National Hydrology Project.
4251111b-206d-81cb-a9ba-001ca4703b42: Godavarman case (1996) = SC said 'forest' means any forest in the dictionary sense, whether or not it's in government records.
4251111b-206d-8148-992e-001c5ed7bef8: CAF Act = Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act: puts the CA money (CAMPA funds) into national and state funds for planting.
4251111b-206d-8183-a37e-001c2cc01b01: e-Green Watch = online portal tracking CA plantations; PARIVESH = online single-window portal for environment and forest clearances.
4251111b-206d-8195-9e10-001c2ea188d6: Deemed forest = land that looks and works like forest but isn't recorded as forest in government papers.
4251111b-206d-8196-85c1-001ca5875dc7: Stage-I = the Centre's in-principle approval for forest diversion; Stage-II = final approval after conditions (like CA) are met.
4251111b-206d-8114-8364-001c3b74d804: Miyawaki method = planting dense, native mini-forests that grow about 10x faster (Japanese technique).
4251111b-206d-8196-b872-001c11a692b0: Bonn Challenge = global pledge to restore degraded land; India pledged 26 million ha by 2030.
4251111b-206d-81d9-987c-001cc6089f0d: Joint Forest Management = forest department and village share forest protection and its produce (started from Sukhomajri, Haryana).
4251111b-206d-81c9-bc9b-001c877f8ed6: Community forest rights (CFR) = the whole village's right to use, protect and manage its traditional forest, not just individual plots.
4251111b-206d-81e6-99ff-001ce84b703d: REDD+ = UN scheme that pays developing countries for keeping forests standing and cutting deforestation emissions.
4251111b-206d-8182-89ce-001cfe58aa6c: Mission Sahbhagita = 'participation' mission: gets local people to protect and use wetlands wisely.
4251111b-206d-8120-92c8-001c229f96e7: Montreux Record = Ramsar's list of sites whose health is getting worse and need urgent attention.
4251111b-206d-815a-9f67-001c940140e3: Wetland City Accreditation = Ramsar title for cities that protect their wetlands (Indore, Udaipur).
4251111b-206d-81f2-b158-001cbd75d625: NPCA = National Plan for Conservation of Aquatic Ecosystems: one scheme for lakes and wetlands (merged 2013).
4251111b-206d-81e8-9cc2-001c55bf643b: Blue carbon = carbon stored by coastal and marine ecosystems: mangroves, seagrass, salt marshes.
4251111b-206d-8170-835f-001c66893666: SAIME = Sustainable Aquaculture In Mangrove Ecosystem: shrimp farming that keeps mangroves standing (Sundarbans pilot).
4251111b-206d-81a5-a396-001ca858d3a1: Biorock = steel frames with a weak electric current that grow limestone, giving corals a base to regrow. Cryobank = freezing coral cells to revive species later.
4251111b-206d-81f4-bf18-001ccd637e84: Gadgil (2011) wanted most of the Western Ghats protected with local say; Kasturirangan (2013) cut it to 37%, focusing on natural landscape only.
4251111b-206d-8123-bd5d-001cfd72f106: Western Ghats Ecology Authority = a body Gadgil proposed to manage the whole range across all 6 states.
4251111b-206d-818d-af65-001cbe63cc51: Minor mineral = sand, gravel, stone etc. under the MMDR Act; states, not the Centre, give and police these leases, so control is weaker.
4251111b-206d-817b-9aaf-001c4c8297a5: Acid mine drainage = rain hits exposed rock in mines, turns acidic and carries heavy metals into rivers and groundwater.
4251111b-206d-8101-a659-001ca66c014f: Tailings dam = a dam holding toxic sludge left after processing ore; when it breaks it floods villages with waste.
4251111b-206d-8188-a4d3-001ce1cf07ba: District Survey Report = each district maps where sand can be mined and how much the rivers refill each year.
4251111b-206d-81b7-8d4a-001cf7cf0ab0: Weighted forest cover = forest area adjusted for how dense it is, so thick forest counts more.
4251111b-206d-816e-9fe3-001c29e7d68c: Inviolate forest = forest that should never be opened to mining; the 2010s replacement for No-Go, applied far more loosely.
4251111b-206d-81c8-a129-001c21a599ac: Saranda = Asia's largest sal forest, in Jharkhand's iron-ore belt; SC made the state declare a sanctuary and plan mining by zones.
4251111b-206d-8181-aa5c-001c53bb509b: MAHASAGAR = India's vision for Indian Ocean cooperation: security and growth for all countries in the region (successor to SAGAR) (new).
4251111b-206d-812a-a682-001c48b5de96: CDRI = Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (India-led, 2019): helps countries build roads, power and hospitals that survive disasters.
4251111b-206d-8126-afe7-001c544a4694: Groynes = low walls built out from the beach into the sea; they trap sand moving along the coast so the beach doesn't wash away.
4251111b-206d-81b1-80d6-001cf2183ab2: Beach nourishment = pumping or dumping fresh sand onto an eroding beach to rebuild it; dunes = natural sand hills behind the beach that absorb waves.
4251111b-206d-8130-9fab-001cb244f832: M-Sand = manufactured sand, made by crushing hard rock; replaces river sand in concrete.
4251111b-206d-8102-b4a8-001cbe7f6015: DMF = District Mineral Foundation: mining companies pay a share of royalty for welfare of mine-affected people (PMKKKY scheme).
4251111b-206d-819c-8c51-001c29f227b0: Sand drift (longshore drift) = waves move sand along the coast; ports and seawalls block it, so beaches beyond them starve and erode.
4251111b-206d-815e-8248-001c295fbc19: Shoreline Management Plan = a coast-wide plan deciding where to protect, let nature act, or retreat.
4251111b-206d-81ae-a9f6-001c325baad1: AR6 = IPCC's 6th Assessment Report (2021–23): the world's main scientific summary of climate change.
4251111b-206d-81fd-93d8-001cd7f5aae6: SR1.5 = IPCC's 2018 special report comparing a 1.5°C world with a 2°C world.
4251111b-206d-8145-a55c-001cf1d81dff: Carbon budget = the total CO₂ the world can still emit and stay under 1.5°C. Once it's spent, warming crosses the line.
4251111b-206d-81ca-8250-001c8b0e716b: Hard-to-abate = heavy industries (steel, cement, fertiliser) and long-distance transport whose emissions can't be cut easily or cheaply just by switching to renewable power.
4251111b-206d-818d-862a-001c0a322c67: MSMEs = Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: small factories and workshops; most still run on coal, diesel or oil and can't afford clean tech.
4251111b-206d-8164-a757-001c3a5b9555: Maunder Minimum = 70 years (1645–1715) with almost no sunspots, so the sun gave slightly less energy and Europe got the 'Little Ice Age'.
4251111b-206d-811c-8409-001cf4a31067: LiFE = Lifestyle for Environment: India's campaign for mindful use (switch off lights, save water, waste less). It shifts the focus from production to consumption.
4251111b-206d-8128-9f35-001cfe03c581: Primary energy = all energy used in its raw form (coal, oil, gas, sun, wind) before it becomes electricity or fuel. Fossil fuels still supply 87% of India's.
4251111b-206d-819b-b3b6-001c68f050e0: GtC = gigatonnes of carbon. 1 gigatonne = 100 crore tonnes.
4251111b-206d-812f-821b-001c3df8e9b7: CBAM = Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism: an EU charge on imports based on the carbon emitted making them, so foreign goods pay the same carbon cost as EU goods.
4251111b-206d-816f-b9bf-001ca3b5673a: ICIMOD = International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (Kathmandu): an 8-country research body for the Hindu Kush Himalaya.
4251111b-206d-81e2-9b37-001c17bb0e1a: Albedo = how much sunlight a surface reflects. Ice reflects a lot; when it melts, the darker ground or sea absorbs more heat, so warming speeds up.
4251111b-206d-8124-b89b-001c6b906c2c: GLOF = glacial lake outburst flood: a lake held back by ice or loose rock bursts and floods valleys downstream.
4251111b-206d-81bb-beaf-001c821b2d53: NMSHE = National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem: the NAPCC mission to study and protect Himalayan glaciers, forests and water. Himansh = India's high-altitude glacier research station in Lahaul-Spiti, Himachal.
4251111b-206d-81cc-b4fe-001c43dbb950: Marine heatwave = days or weeks when a patch of sea stays unusually hot; it bleaches corals and kills fish.
4251111b-206d-8101-b971-001cef4a5c42: Ocean acidification = the sea absorbs CO₂ and turns slightly acidic, so corals and shellfish struggle to build their shells.
4251111b-206d-8165-b633-001c6743ed0a: Blue NDC Challenge = France and Brazil asking countries to put ocean goals into their climate pledges (NDCs) before COP30.
4251111b-206d-81ed-b3e4-001c39efaaec: INCOIS = Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services, Hyderabad: ocean, tsunami and cyclone warnings.
4251111b-206d-81af-bb28-001cd8eca501: Deep Ocean Mission (2021) = India's mission to explore the deep sea for minerals and life, including a crewed submersible (Samudrayaan).
4251111b-206d-816c-8c90-001cb716a23c: ENSO = El Niño–Southern Oscillation: the Pacific swinging between a warm phase (El Niño) and a cool phase (La Niña), which shapes India's monsoon.
4251111b-206d-8115-b146-001c3c0f3aec: Kigali Amendment (2016) = add-on to the Montreal Protocol to cut HFCs, the gases in ACs and fridges that don't harm ozone but heat the planet strongly.
4251111b-206d-8112-bdf2-001cb0ae6af4: India Cooling Action Plan (2019) = plan to meet fast-growing AC and fridge demand with less energy and climate-friendly refrigerants.
4251111b-206d-81da-947d-001ce4102960: Adaptation gap = the difference between what countries need to cope with climate impacts and the money and action actually there.
4251111b-206d-8186-b1e6-001cfd6a2af4: Climate litigation = taking governments or companies to court over climate harm (e.g. MK Ranjitsinh case, ICJ opinion).
4251111b-206d-8154-8499-001c342c5e16: Storm surge = a cyclone's winds pile seawater up and push it onto land, like a sudden high tide.
4251111b-206d-81b3-8501-001ca4d9174f: Dams trap river silt = sand and mud that rivers used to carry to the coast now settle behind dams, so beaches and deltas get no new sand and shrink.
4251111b-206d-81d3-b17c-001c01a86332: NAPCC = National Action Plan on Climate Change (2008). Its 9 missions: Solar, Enhanced Energy Efficiency, Sustainable Habitat, Water, Himalayan Ecosystem, Green India, Sustainable Agriculture, Strategic Knowledge, and Health (the 9th, added later).
4251111b-206d-81ea-9e11-001ca7e7cc79: National Adaptation Plan = a country's plan for coping with climate impacts (heat, floods, crops), prepared under the UNFCCC.
4251111b-206d-8194-9284-001cc9fc06b6: CCTS = Carbon Credit Trading Scheme: India's own carbon market. Firms that beat their emissions target earn credits and sell them to firms that miss it.
4251111b-206d-813d-9b78-001c24c6d04b: GEI Target Rules = Greenhouse gas Emission Intensity rules: fix how much GHG a sector may emit per unit of product (e.g. per tonne of cement).
4251111b-206d-81dc-bf7f-001c68ffad4a: ESCerts = Energy Saving Certificates: earned by firms that save more energy than their PAT target and sold on the power exchange.
4251111b-206d-813d-aeeb-001c47273fa2: CCPA = Central Consumer Protection Authority. Its 2024 guidelines stop companies making false 'eco-friendly' claims (greenwashing).
4251111b-206d-814b-8dd5-001c18849191: Blue hydrogen = hydrogen made from natural gas, with the CO₂ captured and stored so it doesn't reach the air.
4251111b-206d-8194-9097-001cfad0dd0f: Enhanced rock weathering = basalt dust spread on fields reacts with rainwater and CO₂ and locks the carbon away as bicarbonate for ≈10,000 years.
4251111b-206d-814d-862e-001c7c602a83: 3-NOP (and red seaweed) = cattle feed additives that block the stomach enzymes making methane, cutting it 30–80%.
4251111b-206d-8189-9553-001cb7ced245: Direct Ocean Capture = pulling CO₂ out of seawater instead of air; seawater holds far more CO₂, so it's easier to extract.
4251111b-206d-8172-af87-001cd2e96a8e: NICRA = National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (ICAR, 2011): research and village demos of farming that copes with heat, drought and floods.
4251111b-206d-812c-a374-001ce5da9550: DBW-187 = a high-yield wheat variety bred to cope with heat (ICAR wheat institute, Karnal).
4251111b-206d-813b-abaa-001c2c9383b0: Sponge cities = cities built to soak up rain (parks, wetlands, permeable pavements) instead of flooding.
4251111b-206d-8159-b4ed-001c444c3425: MISHTI = Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes: plants mangroves along the coast as a natural wall against storms, with income for locals.
4251111b-206d-817e-be2e-001cb1708ffb: Early Warnings for All = UN goal that every person on Earth is covered by a disaster early-warning system by 2027.
4251111b-206d-81a1-9e79-001c339b777a: Mission Mausam (2024, ₹2,000 crore) = upgrade of India's weather forecasting: more radars and AI, to be 'weather ready and climate smart'.
4251111b-206d-8175-9ee4-001c768f5a1f: Biochar = charcoal made by burning crop waste with little oxygen; mixed into soil, it locks carbon away for centuries and makes the soil richer.
4251111b-206d-8192-b665-001c5ce4a0be: BECCS = Bioenergy with Carbon Capture and Storage: grow energy crops, burn them for power, then capture the CO₂ and store it underground, so the net effect pulls CO₂ out of the air.
4251111b-206d-81a8-bdb6-001c0a2353ae: Refuse-derived fuel (RDF) = dry burnable waste (plastic, paper) shredded into fuel for cement kilns instead of coal.
4251111b-206d-81d5-885b-001cda225128: Parametric insurance = payout comes automatically when a measured trigger is crossed (e.g. rain above X mm); no damage survey needed (Nagaland 2024).
4251111b-206d-81d4-b240-001cb661bbb9: Blended finance = public or donor money takes the first risk so private investors are willing to fund green projects.
4251111b-206d-815c-a30c-001cbc1762bd: Climate budget tagging = marking each budget item by how much it helps climate action, so a state can track its green spending (Odisha first).
4251111b-206d-8181-b786-001c7958bdae: ISA = International Solar Alliance: India–France-led group of sunny countries to spread solar power; HQ in Gurugram.
4251111b-206d-81ec-91cb-001c09136be9: UNFCCC = UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (Rio 1992): the parent climate treaty. COPs are its yearly meetings.
4251111b-206d-81c9-9d05-001c02faa08c: CBDR-RC = everyone must act, but rich countries that caused most of the problem must do more and pay more, according to their capacity.
4251111b-206d-81b3-b8be-001c39ea61aa: Article 9.1 (Paris) = says developed countries 'shall provide' finance to developing ones; India reads it as a legal duty, not charity.
4251111b-206d-8110-bc3d-001c6a407927: Annex I = the list of rich, industrialised countries (USA, UK, Russia, EU…) that had binding cuts under Kyoto.
4251111b-206d-81b0-9b57-001cccb746e0: CDM = Clean Development Mechanism: rich countries funded clean projects in developing countries and counted the cuts as credits (CERs). India was a big winner.
4251111b-206d-81e7-9588-001c4bf7e3ca: BASIC = Brazil, South Africa, India, China: a negotiating group of big developing countries.
4251111b-206d-815e-b67b-001cdc033d3f: NDC = Nationally Determined Contribution: each country's own climate pledge under Paris, renewed every 5 years.
4251111b-206d-81a1-9f1d-001c30b8f25c: Ratchet mechanism = every 5 years each country must submit a stronger pledge than the last. It can only go up, like a ratchet.
4251111b-206d-81d9-916c-001ca18d23b2: Global Stocktake = a 5-yearly check under Paris of whether the world is on track; the first was done at COP28.
4251111b-206d-810a-a6e2-001c9a29c96c: Loss and damage = money for harm that can't be avoided or adapted to (homes washed away, islands lost).
4251111b-206d-8115-96d5-001c7523eeee: LT-LEDS = Long-Term Low Emission Development Strategy: India's 2022 roadmap to net zero by 2070 (green hydrogen, nuclear, ethanol).
4251111b-206d-81b4-8f11-001cfbc38bde: NCQG = New Collective Quantified Goal: the new climate-finance target that replaces the old 100-billion-dollar goal: 300 billion dollars a year by 2035.
4251111b-206d-81e0-873a-001c5db20d97: Article 6.2 = two countries trade carbon credits directly (e.g. Thailand's e-bus cuts counted by Switzerland).
4251111b-206d-81e4-ba7c-001ca5366429: TFFF = a fund that invests money and pays tropical countries every year for each hectare of forest they keep standing.
4251111b-206d-819c-a380-001c0f3bee45: Just transition = moving away from coal and oil without leaving workers and coal regions behind (new jobs, training, support).
4251111b-206d-81fe-8343-001c8e23285f: Global Goal on Adaptation = Paris goal to measure how well countries are coping with climate impacts; COP30 agreed 59 indicators (water, health, infrastructure).
4251111b-206d-815e-8e59-001c84640e2d: PACT = a COP30 initiative to support coal-dependent regions in moving away from coal.
4251111b-206d-81ca-a066-001cf6d602a1: ITLOS = International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (Hamburg): the UN court for ocean law.
4251111b-206d-818d-9883-001c17ae9e19: NAAQS = National Ambient Air Quality Standards: India's legal limits for each pollutant in outdoor air (set by CPCB, 2009).
4251111b-206d-8169-926e-001cfd77d5a3: VOCs = volatile organic compounds: gases from petrol, paints, solvents; with NOx and sunlight they make ozone smog.
4251111b-206d-81ba-bebc-001c4d6bdc0f: Non-attainment city = a city that failed to meet national air quality standards for 5 years in a row.
4251111b-206d-8176-a1d0-001c363af8ef: Source apportionment = a study showing how much pollution comes from each source (vehicles, dust, industry, stubble).
4251111b-206d-8128-8d20-001cd8974c04: SAFAR = System of Air Quality and Weather Forecasting and Research: real-time air-quality forecasts for big cities (IITM Pune).
4251111b-206d-8152-ac5f-001ced60c571: CAQM = Commission for Air Quality Management in NCR and adjoining areas: one body for Delhi's airshed, with power to order and fine. EPCA = the SC-appointed body it replaced.
4251111b-206d-8110-8d02-001c08bf52dc: GRAP = Graded Response Action Plan: restrictions that tighten automatically as AQI worsens (stage I to IV: construction bans, truck bans, school closures).
4251111b-206d-8114-aec1-001ca3397aa4: Emissions trading (Surat) = factories get pollution permits; those that cut more can sell their spare permits to others, so cuts happen where they're cheapest.
4251111b-206d-81f7-9747-001cf133f51d: Gothenburg Protocol = a European treaty that sets national caps on 4 pollutants that drift across borders. UNECE = UN Economic Commission for Europe.
4251111b-206d-8115-aeb6-001cac65268e: CGWB = Central Ground Water Board; CWC = Central Water Commission (surface water). Mihir Shah wanted them merged into one National Water Commission.
4251111b-206d-81b4-8edb-001cae7a2bde: Easement Act 1882 = whoever owns land owns the groundwater under it, so there's no limit on pumping.
4251111b-206d-8165-b5db-001c1c20d1d7: Phytoremediation = using plants to absorb or break down toxins in soil and water. Bioremediation = using microbes for the same.
4251111b-206d-8117-ad1b-001cc6933bf0: NAQUIM = National Aquifer Mapping and Management Programme: maps underground water layers to plan their use.
4251111b-206d-8182-bb6b-001c0787b3b7: Non-revenue water = water a city supplies but never bills for: lost to leaks, theft and faulty meters.
4251111b-206d-812f-9183-001c19a39513: Eutrophication = fertiliser and sewage overfeed algae; the algae bloom, die and rot, using up oxygen, so fish die (dead zones).
4251111b-206d-81e1-b8a0-001c8b64c5d2: E-flow (environmental flow) = the minimum water a river must keep flowing to stay alive for fish, people and the delta.
4251111b-206d-810e-8c04-001cdea9d879: GRACE = NASA–German satellites that measure tiny changes in Earth's gravity to track groundwater loss from space.
4251111b-206d-81ba-a976-001cf6b6b786: NPP = National Perspective Plan for river linking (1980); NWDA = National Water Development Agency, which studies the links.
4251111b-206d-8186-9ef9-001c6a5688d3: Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari = 'water saving through people's participation': villages build recharge structures with local funds and labour.
4251111b-206d-81fe-a54d-001c3a9731d0: Neeru-Chettu = Andhra's 'water and trees' campaign to desilt tanks and plant trees with community help.
4251111b-206d-81d7-b6ca-001c945030fb: Zero liquid discharge (ZLD) = a factory treats and reuses all its wastewater, releasing none.
4251111b-206d-81c1-8462-001cd21aca0d: EPR = Extended Producer Responsibility: the company that sells the product must pay for collecting and recycling it after use.
4251111b-206d-8174-bde5-001cee6c09c3: PWM Rules = Plastic Waste Management Rules (2016, amended many times since).
4251111b-206d-8128-a825-001ca0d82f3d: Project REPLAN = KVIC scheme that mixes plastic waste with cotton fibre to make carry bags.
4251111b-206d-8176-a506-001c2dcd79a0: Plastic Park = an industrial zone with shared facilities for plastic recycling and processing units.
4251111b-206d-81d9-8d73-001c0614f390: Oilzapper = TERI's mix of oil-eating bacteria sprayed on spills to break oil down naturally.
4251111b-206d-8111-b5d9-001c39150b8c: Leachate = the toxic liquid that drains out of rotting garbage and seeps into groundwater.
4251111b-206d-81b7-8a45-001c5b0d66e2: EBWGR = Extended Bulk Waste Generator Responsibility: big generators (malls, hotels) that don't process their wet waste must buy certificates from those who do.
4251111b-206d-8149-b860-001c3c32e773: Refuse-derived fuel (RDF) = dry burnable waste (plastic, paper) shredded into fuel for cement kilns instead of coal.
4251111b-206d-8142-bd49-001c8b855fcd: Biomining = digging up old dumps, sieving the waste and recovering soil, recyclables and fuel. Legacy waste = waste dumped years ago that never got treated.
4251111b-206d-818c-85d9-001cc5cb4d24: DRAP = Dumpsite Remediation Accelerator Programme (SBM-Urban 2.0) to clear old landfills fast.
4251111b-206d-81f3-9d67-001c54e82026: Downcycling = recycling into a lower-value product each time (a bottle becomes a mat), so the material is eventually lost.
4251111b-206d-81fc-8b69-001c74b593cc: Bioleaching = using microbes to pull metals out of e-waste. Hydrometallurgy = dissolving metals out with chemicals instead of burning.
4251111b-206d-8148-a130-001cf7b0bc70: TSDF = Treatment, Storage and Disposal Facility for hazardous waste. CBWTF = Common Bio-medical Waste Treatment Facility shared by hospitals.
4251111b-206d-81a3-8c94-001c175f27b6: Methylmercury = the form mercury takes in water and fish; it builds up the food chain and damages the brain.
4251111b-206d-8173-92c0-001c559a22b0: FGD = flue gas desulphurisation: scrubbers that remove SO₂ from power-plant smoke. Category C plants = those far from big cities and polluted areas.
4251111b-206d-813e-9501-001c435252c4: Contaminated Sites Rules 2025 = rules to find, list and clean up old toxic sites, with the polluter paying.
4251111b-206d-8118-8406-001c53f73949: LDN = Land Degradation Neutrality: restore as much land as is degraded, so net damage is zero.
4251111b-206d-813f-9fbf-001cc1f2356f: PMKSY-WDC = the watershed part of Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: rainwater harvesting and soil conservation on a whole catchment.
4251111b-206d-811c-b072-001c0e41ab1e: Zai pits = small planting pits that trap rain and compost, from the Sahel; they revive dry, hard soil.
4251111b-206d-810b-b480-001c77fe24b7: Beejamrit = seed treatment with cow dung and urine; Jeevamrit = fermented dung-urine mix that feeds soil microbes; Whapasa = soil with both air and moisture in it.
4251111b-206d-81dd-85b2-001c95530457: APCNF = Andhra Pradesh Community-managed Natural Farming: the largest natural farming programme in India.
4251111b-206d-81ab-9f46-001c5ede6641: Green Credit Programme = earn tradable credits for tree planting, water saving and other green actions.
4251111b-206d-8109-9ea4-001c66c3e18f: Capacity vs generation: capacity = how much power plants could make at full tilt; generation = what they actually make. Solar runs only in daylight, so 50% of capacity gives far less than 50% of electricity.
4251111b-206d-8123-ba4b-001c43355a3d: WEF Energy Transition Index = World Economic Forum ranking of how ready countries are to move to clean energy.
4251111b-206d-8149-893e-001cc96903be: Barefoot Women Solar Engineers = rural women trained (Barefoot College, Tilonia) to install and fix solar lights in their villages.
4251111b-206d-8123-a6d3-001cba730a20: SDG 7 = UN goal of affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all by 2030.
4251111b-206d-81db-af4b-001c192f7eb3: CFL = compact fluorescent lamp, the curly tube bulb that came before LEDs.
4251111b-206d-81f0-b4e0-001c052f8014: BESS = Battery Energy Storage System: big battery banks that store solar or wind power and release it when needed (at night, at peak).
4251111b-206d-817d-b7ae-001c5d253167: Stranded assets = coal plants and mines that become unprofitable before they're paid off because cheaper clean power takes over.
4251111b-206d-81e7-b35d-001cf0d23d1d: DISCOM = state power distribution company that buys power and sells it to homes; most are in debt, so they pay generators late.
4251111b-206d-81fe-b12f-001c609d635d: Renewable Energy Management Centres = control rooms that forecast solar and wind output and balance the grid in real time.
4251111b-206d-8159-9f27-001c0848b128: ACC = Advanced Chemistry Cell (lithium-ion and newer batteries); PLI = Production Linked Incentive, cash rewards for making them in India. Pumped storage = pump water uphill when power is spare, release it through turbines when needed: a giant water battery.
4251111b-206d-8102-963d-001ce9c00e81: Methanol = a liquid fuel made from coal, gas or captured CO₂; it can be blended in petrol or used in ships.
4251111b-206d-8199-84e7-001c45718715: Coal gasification = turning coal into gas (syngas) for fuels and chemicals instead of burning it, so pollutants are easier to capture.
4251111b-206d-81e2-a65b-001c34c66e7e: OSOWOG = One Sun One World One Grid: link solar grids across countries so the sun is always shining somewhere. GGI = Green Grids Initiative, its launch platform.
4251111b-206d-8124-9008-001c931b65ca: JETP = Just Energy Transition Partnership: rich countries' finance package to help a country move off coal (South Africa, Indonesia, Vietnam). Green bonds = loans raised from investors only for green projects.
4251111b-206d-81c4-91f5-001c9bfe542e: PERC = a cheaper, more efficient solar cell design; bifacial panels catch sunlight on both sides; thin-film = flexible, lightweight panels.
4251111b-206d-81d8-9c61-001c83bc8185: ALMM = Approved List of Models and Manufacturers: only listed (mostly Indian) solar panels can be used in government-backed projects.
4251111b-206d-81dc-9e51-001cccba899c: Solar Park = a big plot with ready land, roads and grid lines where developers plug in solar plants cheaply.
4251111b-206d-818d-9552-001c72280c20: Reverse auction = developers bid the lowest price per unit to win a project, which pushed solar tariffs down.
4251111b-206d-803f-8fff-001c7c6e0efd: Big minimum project size = central auctions and direct grid connection need large utility-scale wind farms, typically 50 MW or more.
4251111b-206d-81dc-a7c3-001cb10d1434: Repowering = replacing old small wind turbines with taller, stronger ones on the same site to get more power.
4251111b-206d-812a-9d54-001c20529fb0: Wind-solar hybrid = wind and solar at the same site sharing one grid line; wind blows at night, sun in the day.
4251111b-206d-81ef-9662-001c8bb86ebf: VGF (viability gap funding) = a one-time government grant that covers the part of a project's cost the market won't pay.
4251111b-206d-81b5-adfa-001c2efa71da: Run-of-river = a hydro plant that uses the river's natural flow without a big dam or reservoir.
4251111b-206d-81b2-8182-001cf2a34442: Nuclear Energy Mission = Budget 2025–26 push for 100 GW of nuclear power by 2047, incl. small reactors and private players.
4251111b-206d-813c-bcdd-001c7910db03: VVER = Russian-design pressurised water reactor, used at Kudankulam.
4251111b-206d-819b-b76c-001caed89da0: Heavy-water reactor (PHWR) = India's main reactor type, runs on natural uranium and uses heavy water to slow neutrons.
4251111b-206d-8194-bb05-001c59592632: MOX = mixed oxide fuel: uranium plus plutonium. Fast breeder = a reactor that makes more fuel than it burns.
4251111b-206d-815e-8eae-001cce2f0cb1: BHAVINI = Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam, the PSU that built and runs the Kalpakkam fast breeder.
4251111b-206d-81f2-84c6-001c6a90ba83: Cryostat = the giant steel vacuum shell that keeps ITER's magnets super-cold.
4251111b-206d-81ea-8b81-001c51952b5f: Tokamak = a doughnut-shaped machine that holds super-hot plasma with magnets for fusion. Aditya = India's first, at IPR Gandhinagar.
4251111b-206d-816f-887b-001c159a0548: CLNDA = Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act 2010: lets the operator sue suppliers after an accident, which scared foreign suppliers away.
4251111b-206d-8159-affe-001c778c616a: SHANTI Act = the new nuclear law opening the sector to private players and reworking the liability rules.
4251111b-206d-8141-8cef-001ccafcd470: Bharat Small Reactor = 220 MW Indian reactor for captive use by industry. SMR = small modular reactor, factory-built and easy to place.
4251111b-206d-812a-bb52-001cc0ce20a5: Hard-to-abate = heavy industries (steel, cement, fertiliser) whose emissions can't be cut easily just by switching to renewable power.
4251111b-206d-8141-b268-001c5673748e: Electrolysis = splitting water into hydrogen and oxygen using electricity.
4251111b-206d-81d5-b53b-001cd0b48ee4: SIGHT = Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition: incentives for making electrolysers and green hydrogen in India.
4251111b-206d-812e-8a03-001c25014e15: 2G ethanol = ethanol made from crop waste (straw, stalks) instead of food crops.
4251111b-206d-8140-b38f-001cab65af7d: RON 95 = octane rating of petrol; higher octane needed for E20 to run smoothly in engines.
4251111b-206d-8133-a2bc-001c724bb2f4: EBP = Ethanol Blended Petrol programme; E20 = 20% ethanol in petrol.
4251111b-206d-8119-a504-001c868baf46: PM JI-VAN = scheme giving viability gap funding to build 2G ethanol plants.
4251111b-206d-813e-af94-001c7e525a28: Compressed biogas (CBG) = biogas cleaned and compressed to work like CNG in vehicles.
4251111b-206d-81fe-83f5-001ce7497ac8: GOBARdhan = scheme turning cattle dung and farm waste into biogas and manure in villages.
4251111b-206d-811a-aa63-001c35512ff9: FPO = Farmer Producer Organisation: a farmers' company that can collect and sell straw in bulk.
4251111b-206d-80a9-a519-001c295fc7c9: H = human collectives (FPOs running collection depots) with decision-support tools (GIS maps that show planners and FPOs where surplus biomass is).
4251111b-206d-81b7-b980-001cf2955125: Inverted GST = parts (batteries, components) are taxed at 18% but the finished EV only at 5%, so makers can't recover the extra tax paid.
4251111b-206d-81c9-b36e-001c64818919: Vehicle-to-grid = parked EVs feed power back to the grid at peak times.
4251111b-206d-81d5-88f8-001c48299f02: FAME-II = the earlier EV subsidy scheme (2019–24), replaced by PM E-DRIVE.
4251111b-206d-8105-9ad9-001cfe227332: IDMC = Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre, a Geneva body that counts people forced from homes inside their own country.
4251111b-206d-8187-9943-001c40f729ae: Exposure = how many people and how much property sit in the hazard's path. Same quake, empty desert = low exposure; crowded city = high.
4251111b-206d-815e-ae46-001c2d28f41f: Cascading risk = one disaster triggers the next, like dominoes (avalanche → flood → dam breach).
4251111b-206d-81a8-8d87-001cf4e7d31a: Mishra Committee (1976) = panel that warned Joshimath sits on old landslide debris and asked for curbs on heavy construction; ignored.
4251111b-206d-818f-b1b0-001c030836d2: GAR = UN Global Assessment Report on Disaster Risk Reduction (by UNDRR), published every few years.
4251111b-206d-81e9-8e8f-001c9044c05c: CDRI = Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure: India-led global body (2019) helping countries build roads, power and hospitals that survive disasters.
4251111b-206d-81df-a060-001ca57b4795: Exercise Suraksha Chakra = large mock drill for an earthquake in Delhi-NCR (2025) run by NDMA with the Army.
4251111b-206d-8186-bbeb-001cdff5dee0: Disaster Risk Index = a score for each state's hazard + exposure + vulnerability; the Finance Commission uses it to share disaster funds.
4251111b-206d-8112-869a-001c438c0109: SDRF = State Disaster Response Fund (money for relief after a disaster); SDMF = State Disaster Mitigation Fund (money to cut risk before one). NDRF / NDMF = the national versions.
4251111b-206d-8164-99f3-001ca33fa994: Debt-for-resilience swap = a lender forgives part of a country's debt if the money saved is spent on disaster-proofing.
4251111b-206d-8153-bb54-001c7fab5229: Parametric insurance = pays out automatically when a measured trigger is crossed (rain above X mm, wind above Y km/h), no loss survey needed.
4251111b-206d-8150-a2cf-001c2d009bca: PMFBY = Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana, crop insurance for farmers at low premiums.
4251111b-206d-81ce-a901-001c5326f0f5: Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act (Dec 2025) = insurance law amendment allowing 100% FDI in insurers and easing rules to widen cover.
4251111b-206d-8182-a871-001c34e91eb1: IRDAI = Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India, the insurance regulator.
4251111b-206d-8134-9f7b-001c3e4fbf32: NDRF here = National Disaster Response Force, the specialist rescue force. Don't mix it up with the NDRF fund (National Disaster Response Fund).
4251111b-206d-817e-8223-001c98dfa9d4: Incident Response System = a fixed chain of command at a disaster site: who leads, who handles operations, logistics and planning, so nobody waits for orders.
4251111b-206d-81de-8c1b-001c842cb16e: ERSS-112 = Emergency Response Support System: one number, 112, for police, fire, ambulance. Golden hour = the first hour or so after a disaster, when rescue saves the most lives.
4251111b-206d-81e2-b7a8-001c9490774f: PDNA (post-disaster needs assessment) = a survey after a disaster of damage, losses and what it will cost to rebuild.
4251111b-206d-81a0-83e2-001cc2d21b2f: SACHET / Common Alerting Protocol = one standard format for disaster alerts so the same warning goes out on SMS, TV, radio and apps at once.
4251111b-206d-811d-9a21-001c23966392: Cell broadcast = an alert pushed to every phone in an area at once, even without the number on a list.
4251111b-206d-8199-a146-001cdad4be6d: Mission Mausam (2024) = IMD programme to make India weather-ready: more radars, supercomputers, AI forecasts.
4251111b-206d-81e5-a39d-001c20fc96d2: Nowcast = a forecast for the next few hours, very local (thunderstorm in the next 3 hours over this block).
4251111b-206d-8169-8ecf-001c5dd29d52: INCOIS = Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services, Hyderabad; runs India's tsunami warning centre.
4251111b-206d-81e5-a299-001c35133d17: Aapda Mitra = NDMA scheme training local volunteers in first response (search, rescue, first aid) in disaster-prone districts.
4251111b-206d-8178-a9a8-001c0c8b752d: Web-DCRA = web-based Dynamic Composite Risk Atlas: NDMA's online risk map that combines hazards, people and assets.
4251111b-206d-8156-bc1b-001c6e6da970: Operation Dost = India's rescue and relief mission after the Türkiye–Syria earthquake (2023).
4251111b-206d-81f5-b39a-001c91532b3a: Bailey bridge = a prefabricated steel bridge the Army can assemble quickly by hand.
4251111b-206d-819d-8a35-001cf881ee95: National Executive Committee = NDMA's working arm, chaired by the Union Home Secretary; turns NDMA policy into action.
4251111b-206d-8137-bee2-001cd719bb75: NIDM = National Institute of Disaster Management: trains officials and does DM research.
4251111b-206d-810a-9c5a-001c38a4445a: PM's 10-point agenda (2016) = India's DRR priorities: DRR in all development, risk cover for all, women's leadership, risk mapping, tech, local capacity, etc.
4251111b-206d-81d3-83bb-001c39b43e41: Build back better = rebuild stronger and safer than before, not just as it was.
4251111b-206d-81a3-a976-001c3edf8af3: Hyogo Framework (2005–15) = earlier UN DRR plan, focused on managing disasters; replaced by Sendai (2015–30), which focuses on managing risk.
4251111b-206d-8187-913c-001c39d1801c: Epidemic Diseases Act 1897 = colonial law letting governments take special measures in epidemics (used in COVID-19).
4251111b-206d-81bf-b50a-001c295d48f3: IS 1893 = BIS code that maps India into seismic zones (II = low to V = highest) and sets how buildings must resist quakes.
4251111b-206d-810e-a743-001c2100292c: Reservoir-induced quake = the weight and water pressure of a big dam's lake triggers quakes (Koyna 1967).
4251111b-206d-81f4-829f-001cff067805: Liquefaction = during shaking, wet sandy soil loses strength and behaves like liquid, so buildings sink or tilt.
4251111b-206d-8154-831a-001cdce005a4: GSDMA = Gujarat State Disaster Management Authority, set up after Bhuj 2001.
4251111b-206d-8183-9139-001c6334c202: Megathrust quake = the biggest kind of quake, where one tectonic plate slides under another along a huge fault.
4251111b-206d-81cc-90cf-001cf05f53d6: Bio-shield = a belt of mangroves or coastal trees that breaks the force of waves and wind.
4251111b-206d-81f6-acf9-001c6618b496: C-FLOOD = a web platform (CWC + C-DAC) giving village-level flood inundation forecasts up to 2 days ahead. 74th Amendment (next line) = gave urban local bodies constitutional status and listed their functions (12th Schedule).
4251111b-206d-8117-b12d-001c4d4d8a33: NLRMS = National Landslide Risk Management Strategy (2019).
4251111b-206d-817b-beb5-001cae454be4: Bhusanket = GSI portal sharing landslide susceptibility maps and early warnings.
4251111b-206d-81ad-af9e-001c9b06d367: InSAR = satellite radar that compares images over time to spot the ground moving by millimetres.
4251111b-206d-81ae-b13c-001ca0272678: Orographic lift = moist air forced up a mountain cools and dumps rain.
4251111b-206d-8140-94e3-001c2201b39c: Cumulonimbus = towering thunderstorm cloud that brings heavy rain, lightning and hail.
4251111b-206d-814f-b2e2-001caf6ada13: Coriolis force = the Earth's spin deflects winds, which makes cyclones spin; too weak near the equator, so cyclones don't form there.
4251111b-206d-8112-9fce-001cde38bdbe: Wind shear = winds changing speed or direction with height; low shear lets a cyclone grow tall without being torn apart.
4251111b-206d-81b1-862f-001cdc31718e: OSDMA = Odisha State Disaster Management Authority, India's first state DM authority (1999, after the super cyclone).
4251111b-206d-812a-aeca-001c979cd744: DPAP = Drought Prone Areas Programme: watershed and soil-water conservation in drought districts.
4251111b-206d-819a-855e-001c0fbdee85: Urban heat island = cities stay hotter than the countryside because concrete and roads soak up heat and release it at night.
4251111b-206d-81c7-9fb9-001c58e03c48: NAPFF = National Action Plan on Forest Fires (2018).
4251111b-206d-81fa-a7a8-001c56d55085: SNPP-VIIRS = a NASA-NOAA satellite sensor that spots active fires from space.
4251111b-206d-81d0-8406-001c823076e2: Moraine = loose rock and debris left by a glacier; a lake dammed by a moraine can burst suddenly (GLOF).
4251111b-206d-819b-bd6a-001c8adf726e: ICIMOD = International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development, Kathmandu: 8-country body on the Hindu Kush Himalaya.
4251111b-206d-815d-b7c2-001c23cbbd9f: ROV = remotely operated vehicle: a small robot submarine for inspecting dams underwater.
4251111b-206d-8140-bf88-001c1542746b: DRIP = Dam Rehabilitation and Improvement Project (World Bank-backed); DHARMA = Dam Health and Rehabilitation Monitoring Application, the online database of dam health.
4251111b-206d-8191-885a-001c22002423: Major Accident Hazard unit = a factory storing enough hazardous chemicals that an accident could hit people outside the gate.
4251111b-206d-8196-b509-001c8bba19bd: MSIHC Rules 1989 = Manufacture, Storage and Import of Hazardous Chemicals Rules: safety reports, on-site emergency plans, informing the public. Public Liability Insurance Act 1991 = factories handling hazardous substances must carry insurance to give quick relief to accident victims, no proof of fault needed.
4251111b-206d-814e-8e47-001c64387841: Art 243W + 12th Schedule = municipalities' powers and functions list; fire services is one item, so it's local/state work.
4251111b-206d-818d-891b-001c964a0bcf: Failure-mode analysis = list every way an event can go wrong (gate jams, rumour, power cut) and plan for each in advance.
4251111b-206d-8162-8b91-001cd686377a: FIST = Force, Information, Space, Time: crowds turn deadly with too much pushing force, wrong information, too little space, for too long.
